plugin_description: Bar widget showing tenpo ko (elemental time): the UTC day split into four six-hour blocks, fire/air/water/earth.

name_style.label: Block name
name_style.description: Label the current block with its English element name, its toki pona name, or not at all.
name_style.toki_pona: Toki pona (tenpo seli, kon, telo, ma)

drop_tenpo_prefix.label: Drop "tenpo" prefix
drop_tenpo_prefix.description: Show just the element word (seli, kon, telo, ma) without the leading "tenpo".

show_emoji.label: Show emoji
show_emoji.description: Prefix the label with the block's element emoji.

show_seconds.label: Show seconds
show_seconds.description: Show the seconds digits in the time within the block.
